title.narrative: COVID-19: Emergency Assistance for Fighting the COVID-19 Pandemic

description.narrative: The emergency project was prepared in response to the Government of Pakistan's request to the Asian Development Bank (ADB) on 25 March 2020 for assistance in managing the outbreak of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) in Pakistan. The project aims to provide (i) immediate financing to help the government deal with the crisis quickly and flexibly by strengthening its public health preparedness and responsiveness; and (ii) a social protection component for quick financial support to help meet the basic needs of vulnerable and poor segments of society and to stimulate the domestic economy.

Data Source: National economic data; BISP monitoring and evaluation reports Actual value:

Improved health system capacity to detect, assess, notify, report on, and respond to public health risk, with International Health Regulations Country Score for Pakistan rising to 55% (2020 baseline: 49%) Progress/Status: The health component could not be executed due to recurring delays in approval of PC-1. The associated Loan has been cancelled ($100 million) and loan account closed.
However, the Norwegian Grant associated with the project has been extended for 16 months till 31 March 2024, based on the borrowers request and will contribute to the this component. The Norway grant was closed on 31 March 2024 with the committed amount of $4.9 million. The grant is in the process of being financially closed during the winding-up period.
